Package gov.cdc.izgateway.soap

Enum Class MockMessage

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<MockMessage>
gov.cdc.izgateway.soap.MockMessage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<MockMessage>, Constable
public enum MockMessage extends Enum<MockMessage>
MockMessage provides the a Mock for an IIS that enables test driven control of IIS Behavior. These messages are used when MSH-5 is "TEST", and MSH-6 matches one of the defined test cases in the test plan.

    • getMessage

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> getMessage(SoapMessage message) throws Fault
      Get the message response this mock is intended to return.
      Parameters:
      message - The SOAP message object, used again to return a non-XML body.
      Returns:
      The mocked response
      Throws:
      Fault - To mock a generic fault
      SecurityFault - To mock a security fault.
      MessageTooLargeFault - To mock a MessageTooLargeFault
      UnsupportedOperationFault - To mock an unsupported operation

    • getExpected

      public Object getExpected()
      Return the object that describes the expected behavior of this mock. This is used for unit testing of the Mock. This will be: A SubmitSingleMessageResponse for normal transmission and responses A ResponseEntity for non-SOAP Bodies An Exception for exceptions that are intentionally thrown.
      Returns:
      the object that describes the expected behavior

    • getMock

      public static MockMessage getMock(String identifier)
      Get a MockMessage cooresponding to an identifier. Used by IISService to determine which messages should be responded to by a mock.
      Parameters:
      identifier - The test case identifier (the enumeration name) to find.
      Returns:
      The MockMessage that will execute that test case.
